data.name: Grimslair
data.detailed_description:
Your father is Grim, the Grim Reaper. To bring Isabella back from the dead, you must hunt monsters, tear power from their souls, and build a deck strong enough to defeat him.

Grimslair is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder set in a hand-painted world that changes every run and grows deadlier each night.

CREATE CARDS THAT SHOULD NOT EXIST

Blank Battle Cards let you build new cards from scratch. Soulwords ripped from fallen enemies reshape your cards with new damage, targeting, resource gains, status effects, and dangerous tradeoffs. Cards also level up as you use them, so the deck you start with is never the deck you finish with.

BREAK GRIM'S CHAINS

Grim deals enemy cards onto a five-slot chain. Connected cards can unleash multiple attacks and effects in a single turn. Play cards to charge your Chain Breaker, then shatter a connection before the full chain activates.

EXPLORE, BARGAIN, OR KILL

Every run rearranges its paths, locations, enemies, and rewards. Cross graveyards, forests, caves, deserts, and frozen mountains as the clock races toward nightfall. Choose a safer route or risk deeper territory for greater rewards.

Trade with strange vendors or kill them and take everything. Give souls to Grim for perks or keep them to unlock more Soulwords. When a choice goes wrong, Time Warp cards let you turn back the clock.

FIGHT BESIDE YOUR DOG

Your husky fights with its own cards, abilities, and upgrades. Build its deck, strengthen its attacks, and turn your companion into a lethal part of your strategy. Yes, you can pet your dog.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

  • 140+ Battle Cards... Most Can Be Modified

  • 250+ Soulwords and Card Modifiers

  • 50+ Run-Changing Perks

  • 24 Unique Enemies, Each with Special Abilities

  • 7 Unique Bosses

Every card, character, and piece of game art was hand-painted by the solo developer over nearly 6 years.

Content notice: dark fantasy violence, blood/gore, death, grief, and mild horror.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (build 1909)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 or GTX 1650 / AMD RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 (8 GB) or AMD RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5, 64-bit
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU, Apple M1 graphics, or AMD Radeon Pro 560X or better
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and Metal-compatible graphics
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro / M2 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro / M2 graphics or AMD Radeon Pro 5300M / 5500M or better
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or Steam Deck APU
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible GPU, NVIDIA GTX 970 / GTX 1650, AMD RX 570, or Steam Deck APU
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Requires 64-bit Linux and Vulkan-compatible drivers
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.5+, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
